gold_comments.issue_summary: 🟡 Suggestion: This adds an additional database query to every organization list request. Consider if the user object is already available from the authentication context (e.g., via the request state or middleware) to avoid the extra query. If this endpoint is frequently called, the performance impact could be noticeable.
gold_comments.evidence_requirement: The added line `user = await UserStore.get_user_by_id_async(user_id)` must be cited as introducing a new database query per request.
gold_comments.rationale: A human reviewer would raise this to prevent unnecessary performance degradation on a frequently-called endpoint.
